knowledge_cards.claim: A fixed-delays CLI label does not establish the complete fixed-paper baseline; enumerate every trainable parameter.
Fixed delays with a trainable orthogonal matrix is not the fixed-Hadamard condition.
Trainable early-reflection taps confound a delay-state A/B unless frozen.
A hidden delay-range scale changes modal density before optimization.
Filter-initialization drift is a reproduction failure until isolated.
Moving tone EQ across a branch sum changes which components are colored.
Clean validation on the fitted RIR is an optimization monitor rather than held-out-room evidence.
A one-target expected file and gradient smoke test do not reproduce a nine-room ablation table.
Independently peak-normalized artifacts cannot validate absolute gain or headroom.
Loss weights selected on one unidentified held-out RIR have unresolved robustness.
Three excluded virtual-listener positions do not remove same-model circularity.
Model-based spatial trade-offs need independent endpoints before perceptual promotion.
